q: Energy demand depends on different socioeconomic factors such as population, urbanization, industrialization, net capital income and _____.
e: Energy demand depends on different socioeconomic factors such as population, urbanization, industrialization, net capital income and development of technologies.

q: The energy crisis is a situation in which a nation suffers from a disruption of energy supplies connected by increasing energy prices that threaten _____.
e: It is a situation in which a nation suffers from a disruption of energy supplies connected by increasing energy prices that threaten economic and national security.

q: At present day, the rate of formation of fossil fuels is estimated to be about _____ kW.
e: The rate of formation of fossil fuels is estimated to be about 4 billion kW ($4 \times 10^9$ kW).

q: Energy demand forecasting is crucial for ensuring future _____ and environmental security.
e: Energy demand forecasting is crucial for ensuring future economic growth and environmental security.

q: Today's world consumption of energy is of the order of _____ Btu/year.
e: Today's world consumption of energy is of the order of $10^{17}$ Btu/year.

q: Because the population and new technology are always expanding, demand for energy is expected to _____ year by year.
e: Because the population and new technology are always expanding demand for energy is expected to increase year by year.

q: Using the conversion $1 \text{ Btu} = 1055 \text{ J}$ and $1 \text{ year} = 3.15 \times 10^7 \text{ s}$, $10^{17} \text{ Btu/year}$ is equal to _____ W.
The energy crisis is the concern that the world's demands on the _____ natural resources that are used to power industrial society are diminishing as the demand rises.
e: The energy crisis is the concern that the world's demands on the limited natural resources are diminishing.

q: Renewable energy has huge potential to provide solution to increase energy crisis and it is the key factor to the future of energy, food and _____ security.
e: Renewable energy is the key factor to the future of energy, food and economic security.
